Three emperors, one amphitheatre, begun in 72

The Colosseum was begun under Vespasian in 72 and completed in AD 80 under Titus, with later changes by Domitian.

Prague's Horse Market, renamed for a saint in 1848

Wenceslas Square was the Horse Market of Prague's New Town; Karel Havlíček Borovský proposed its new name in 1848.
